vulnerable_code:
class MedicalRecordViewSet(mixins.RetrieveModelMixin, viewsets.GenericViewSet):
    queryset = MedicalRecord.objects.all()
    serializer_class = MedicalRecordSerializer
    lookup_field = 'record_uuid'
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
diagnosis: The GenericViewSet exposes medical records by record_uuid using an unscoped global queryset. It lacks an object-level permission class or a customized get_queryset() to ensure patients only view their own medical charts or doctors only access their assigned patients.
